event.title: Direct Flights to Lebanon Resume After 40 Years Following Trump Meeting
event.canonical_title: Direct Flights to Lebanon Resume After 40 Years Following Trump Meeting
event.summary: In a historic move, direct flights between the US and Lebanon will resume after a 40-year suspension. This announcement follows a meeting between US President Donald Trump and Lebanese President Joseph Aoun, marking Aoun's first visit to the White House since 2009. During the meeting, Trump expressed strong support for Lebanon, coinciding with rare direct talks between Lebanon and Israel mediated by the US.
